reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Puerto Rico
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Are the circumstances that postpone the execution of a writ of eviction specified?
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario facts (question)
   ========================= */

scenario_state(puerto_rico).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The question is abstract: it asks whether the law specifies circumstances that postpone execution.
scenario_topic(execution_of_writ_postponement_specified).

scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(puerto_rico),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_topic(execution_of_writ_postponement_specified).


/* =========================
   Statute effective dates
   ========================= */

% PR Laws tit. 1,  51.5 (2020). Assume effective from 2020 onward for this task.
statute_effective_year(pr_laws_t1_51_5, 2020).

statute_in_effect(StatuteId, State, Year) :-
    State = puerto_rico,
    statute_effective_year(StatuteId, StartYear),
    integer(Year),
    Year >= StartYear.


/* ============================================================
   Statute translation: PR Laws tit. 1,  51.5 (2020)
   ============================================================ */

% [1] PR Laws tit. 1,  51.5 (2020)
% If the writ of execution is directed against the property of the judgment debtor,
% it requires the marshal/sheriff (or court-designated person) to enforce the judgment
% with interest and costs on the debtor's property.
statute_51_5_duty_enforce_on_debtor_property(State, Year) :-
    statute_in_effect(pr_laws_t1_51_5, State, Year).

% [1] PR Laws tit. 1,  51.5 (2020)
% When debtor has assets whose value is greater than judgment amount + costs,
% the marshal/sheriff must levy only the portion indicated by debtor, provided
% it is amply sufficient to cover judgment + accrued interest + accrued costs.
statute_51_5_debtor_may_designate_portion_if_sufficient(State, Year, PropertyValue, JudgmentAmount, AccruedInterest, AccruedCosts) :-
    statute_in_effect(pr_laws_t1_51_5, State, Year),
    number(PropertyValue),
    number(JudgmentAmount),
    number(AccruedInterest),
    number(AccruedCosts),
    Total is JudgmentAmount + AccruedInterest + AccruedCosts,
    PropertyValue > Total.

statute_51_5_officer_must_levy_only_designated_portion(State, Year, PropertyValue, JudgmentAmount, AccruedInterest, AccruedCosts, DesignatedPortionValue) :-
    statute_51_5_debtor_may_designate_portion_if_sufficient(State, Year, PropertyValue, JudgmentAmount, AccruedInterest, AccruedCosts),
    number(DesignatedPortionValue),
    Total is JudgmentAmount + AccruedInterest + AccruedCosts,
    DesignatedPortionValue >= Total.

% [1] PR Laws tit. 1,  51.5 (2020)
% A writ of execution of a judgment obtained under summary procedure Rule 60
% may not be executed on Saturday, Sunday, holidays, or outside working hours,
% unless an imperative necessity is shown.
statute_51_5_applies_to_writ_type(summary_rule60).

statute_51_5_prohibited_day(saturday).
statute_51_5_prohibited_day(sunday).
statute_51_5_prohibited_day(holiday).

statute_51_5_prohibited_hour(outside_working_hours).

statute_51_5_execution_prohibited_time(DayKind, HourKind) :-
    ( statute_51_5_prohibited_day(DayKind)
    ; statute_51_5_prohibited_hour(HourKind)
    ).

statute_51_5_execution_allowed(State, Year, WritType, DayKind, HourKind, ImperativeNecessityShown) :-
    statute_in_effect(pr_laws_t1_51_5, State, Year),
    statute_51_5_applies_to_writ_type(WritType),
    ( ImperativeNecessityShown = yes ->
        true
    ; ImperativeNecessityShown = no,
      \+ statute_51_5_execution_prohibited_time(DayKind, HourKind)
    ).

% Derived concept: circumstances that postpone execution exist if the statute defines
% any prohibited times (which would require postponement absent imperative necessity).
legal_circumstances_that_postpone_execution_specified(State, Year) :-
    statute_in_effect(pr_laws_t1_51_5, State, Year),
    statute_51_5_execution_prohibited_time(_SomeDayKind, _SomeHourKind),
    !.


/* =========================
   Answer logic
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    legal_circumstances_that_postpone_execution_specified(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.


/* =========================
   Main
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are the circumstances that postpone the execution of a writ of eviction specified?
